title: Fix dynamic object light leaking in LightmapGI when Interior is enabled

milestone.title: 4.x
milestone.description: Issues and pull requests slated for an undetermined Godot 4 release.

body:
When **Interior** is enabled, black out probes located near the LightmapGI's bounds so that dynamic objects don't receive lighting from them.

Note that https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/83420 does not supersede this PR, as it never excludes the 8 probes located at the AABB's vertices which are required for probe interpolation to work. These probes cannot be removed, so instead, they need to be made black in interior scenes to avoid light leaks.

- This closes https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/102949.

**Testing project:** [lightmap-colors-3.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/18856492/lightmap-colors-3.zip)
